key_provisions_or_claims: Applies to generative AI services offered to the public in mainland China; R&D without public provision is exempt
Providers must use lawfully sourced data and models, respect IP, obtain consent for personal information, and prevent discrimination
Content must uphold socialist core values; illegal content must be stopped, remedied and reported
AI-generated images and video must be labelled; services with public opinion influence require security assessment and algorithm filing
Inclusive, prudent, tiered supervision; penalties under existing laws, with warnings and suspension of services as fallback
annotation.summary_en: Interim Measures for the Management of Generative AI Services (Order No. 15, effective 15 Aug 2023), issued by the CAC with six other ministries. It sets obligations for providers on training data, content, labelling, personal information, complaints and security assessment, under inclusive, prudent, tiered supervision.
annotation.title_clean: 生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法
annotation.title_en: Interim Measures for the Management of Generative Artificial Intelligence Services
